skill_name: Design a resume layout using Microsoft Word.
workflow: Using Microsoft Word, you can easily create a resume that showcases your qualifications and stands out from the rest. Begin by having a header with your name, address, phone number, and email. Then include a summary section that gives an overview of your work experience, qualifications, and skills. After that, list each of your professional experiences in greater detail, starting with recent roles and listing chronologically backwards.
